name: Com chay sot de
summary: Cơm cháy sốt dê is the crisp rice cake with goat sauce. The 15 February 2023 culture page names it both as a way to eat cơm cháy and as one of the dê núi dishes.
origin: Ninh Bình, at the goat table and as the crisp-rice gift served with sauce.
howToEat: Break the cake into the goat sauce at the table.
where: The same roads as the goat shops. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Com chay sot de — crisp rice, goat sauce
seoDescription: Crisp rice with goat sauce, named on the Ninh Bình culture page of 15 February 2023.
